description: OSHA lists inspections opened since 2012 for one worksite or by year across one employer's worksites. For one worksite, the tool returns the latest 25 inspections with totals. It returns inspection type, citation items by class (serious, willful, repeat, other), initial and current penalties, and whether citations are contested or final. It includes only inspections whose name and street address match the worksite. A contested or non-final citation is OSHA's allegation, not a finding.

employer_id.description: The employer_id from a worksite record.
